author: Warhammer
description:
Cogforts are hulking, mobile towers, carrying massive cannons and a highly trained crew that are ready to crush their foes under iron feet.

The Cogfort has a huge array of options to choose from in the box. With that in mind, we thought it’d be really fun to go through the process of building it and showcase some of those awesome options. Tune in and follow along as Ollie builds this incredible miniature.

If you enjoyed this and want to learn more, our YouTube channel has an array of beginner-friendly videos to get you started.
